start: Menu, Diet plans ('Send members what to eat'); gym is online

user_sees: Sheet 'New diet plan': 'Veg' (No eggs, meat or fish), 'Non-veg' (With eggs, chicken or fish), 'Start empty'
'Each ready-made plan is for an adult of about 60 to 70 kg who trains 3 to 5 days a week. It uses everyday Indian food and is not medical advice.'
must_not: The button live while offline

steps.action: Pick a ready-made plan, change a meal, choose who gets it, tap 'Save plan'
user_sees: 'Saving…', then the plan in the list
must_not: Two plans from one save, or the plan sent to members who were not picked

user_sees: 'Your gym's diet plans' with 'Already sent' on plans the member has, 'Start from a ready-made plan', 'Write a new plan'
must_not: A plan sent twice to the same member

user_sees: The plan shown under the member's 'Diet plan'
must_not: Another member added to the plan

user_sees: Sheet 'Add measurements': 'Day measured', 'Body weight (kg)', 'Body fat (%)', 'Tape measurements (cm)', 'Desk note (only your gym sees it)'
must_not: A future day accepted

user_sees: 'Measurements saved. <name> sees them in the MettleUp app.'
With two or more entries: 'Numbers in brackets show the change since the previous measurement.'
must_not: The entry saved on another member

start: Diet plans and a member's measurements

steps.action: Save a diet plan with no name, or measurements with every box empty
user_sees: A problem line in the sheet and nothing saved (exact words not read)
must_not: An empty plan or an empty measurement sent to the member

steps.action: Open Diet plans in a gym that is not online
user_sees: 'Diet plans need your gym online'; on the member page 'Measurements are kept on your gym's server. Put your gym online first (Settings → Sign-in & data).'
must_not: An endless 'Loading…'

start: Diet plans list with one plan; a member with one measurement

user_sees: 'Withdraw this plan?' with 'Keep it' and a red 'Withdraw'; then 'Plan withdrawn.' and the plan under 'Members no longer get these.'
must_not: The member still seeing a withdrawn plan

steps.action: Open the measurement, change a number, save; then delete it
user_sees: 'Fix measurements' sheet, 'Measurements updated.'
'Delete these measurements?' then 'Measurements deleted.'
must_not: A deleted measurement still in the member's app

steps.action: Type a desk note and save
user_sees: The note on the gym's side only; the page says 'Members see these in their MettleUp app (Progress → Body) after they check in at the gym once.'
must_not: The desk note shown to the member; weight or body fat of a member readable by another gym
